Name: Growable Hardwood
Author: ChillsEmporium
Description:
Growable Hardwood – Stardew Valley Mod Description:
This mod allows players to grow wood mod quicker and easier to get trather than a tree as a crop in [i]Stardew Valley[/i]. You can purchase stone seeds from Pierre’s General Store. Once planted, they take 4 days to fully grow.[line]Planned Features[list]
[*]Add availability to JojaMart for late-game progression (pending investigation).
[*]Continue developing and refining artwork for the stone plant.
[/list][line]Installation Instructions[list=1]
[*]Download and Extract
After downloading the mod, extract the contents.
[*]Move the Mod Folder
Place the folder named Growable Stone into:
[code]Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods
[/code]
[*]Install Required Dependencies
This mod requires the following:[list]
[*]SMAPI – The mod loader for Stardew Valley.
[*]JSON Assets – Required for adding custom items and crops.
[*]SpaceCore – A core library used by many mods.
[/list]To install Json Assets and SpaceCore, extract each mod and move their folders to the same[code] locationMods[/code]folder as above.
For SMAPI, follow the included installer instructions for your version of the game. A video tutorial will be provided soon to assist with installation.
[/list][line]Uninstall the mod, simply delete the Growable Stone folder from your[code]Mods[/code]directory.[line]Bug Reports & Balancing you encounter any bugs or have suggestions for balancing or improvements, please reach out. Your feedback is very much appreciated.[line]Want to Help? If you're an artist or coder and would like to collaborate on this or future mods, feel free to contact me! I'm planning to release many more mods in the future.[line]Requirements[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[/list][list]
[/list][line]Tools Used[list]
[*]Visual Studio 2022
[*]GIMP
[/list][line]Credits[list]
[*]Markchill – Mod concept, coding, and Hardwood plant artwork
[*]ErosDkAi – Original seed sprite from the [i]Growable Ore[/i] mod, generously shared for this project
[/list][line]Support the ModIf you enjoy this mod, please consider supporting the development. Donations are welcome and help make future content possible.
